note: Business-model archetypes for classifying every PDL company. Two levels: group, then archetype. Definitions are literal and short because Jev reads them literally and they are sent with every batch. 'other' in each group catches companies that fit the group but no archetype.

sales_distribution.label: Sales, distribution & dealers
sales_distribution.definition: Resells, distributes or brokers products made by others

archetypes.equipment_dealer: Sells, rents and services equipment made by others (farm, construction, industrial, forklifts)
archetypes.auto_dealer: Sells new or used cars, trucks, boats, RVs or motorcycles to consumers
archetypes.wholesale_distributor: Buys goods in bulk from manufacturers and resells to businesses
archetypes.industrial_supply: Distributes industrial parts, tools, fasteners, MRO or electrical supplies
archetypes.building_materials_supply: Sells lumber, roofing, plumbing, HVAC or building supplies to contractors
archetypes.manufacturers_rep: Independent sales agency selling manufacturers' products on commission
archetypes.import_export_trading: Trading company importing or exporting goods between countries
archetypes.equipment_rental: Rents equipment, tools, vehicles or party gear for short periods
archetypes.other: Distribution or resale business not listed above

staffing_hr.label: Staffing, recruiting & HR services
staffing_hr.definition: Places workers or provides people services to other companies

archetypes.staffing_agency: Places temporary or contract workers with client companies
archetypes.recruitment_firm: Recruits permanent hires for clients for a placement fee (incl. executive search)
archetypes.peo_payroll_services: Provides outsourced payroll, HR administration or PEO services
archetypes.hr_consulting: Advises companies on HR, compensation, benefits or organizational design
archetypes.training_provider: Sells corporate training, coaching or professional development

real_estate.label: Real estate
real_estate.definition: Buys, sells, leases, manages or develops property

archetypes.residential_brokerage: Real estate agency whose agents sell homes for commission
archetypes.commercial_brokerage: Brokers commercial property sales and leases for commission
archetypes.property_management: Manages rental properties, tenants and maintenance for owners
archetypes.real_estate_developer: Develops and builds residential or commercial property projects
archetypes.mortgage_broker_lender: Originates or brokers mortgages and home loans
archetypes.title_escrow: Provides title insurance, escrow or closing services
archetypes.real_estate_investment: Owns and invests in property portfolios (REIT, real estate fund)
archetypes.other: Real estate business not listed above

financial_insurance.label: Financial services & insurance
financial_insurance.definition: Provides money, credit, investment, insurance or payment services

archetypes.insurance_agency: Sells insurance policies from carriers to clients for commission
archetypes.bank_credit_union: Bank or credit union taking deposits and making loans
archetypes.lender_specialty_finance: Non-bank lender: business loans, equipment finance, consumer credit
archetypes.wealth_management: Financial advisors managing investments for individuals for fees
archetypes.investment_firm: Asset manager, private equity, venture capital or hedge fund
archetypes.accounting_firm: Accounting, bookkeeping, audit or tax preparation practice
archetypes.payments_fintech: Technology company providing payments, banking or financial software

software_tech.label: Software & technology
software_tech.definition: Builds or sells software, internet or IT products and services

archetypes.consumer_app: Builds apps or internet products for consumers
archetypes.marketplace_platform: Online marketplace connecting buyers and sellers for a fee
archetypes.it_services_msp: Managed IT services, IT support or network management for businesses
archetypes.software_consultancy: Custom software development agency or systems integrator
archetypes.cybersecurity: Security software or security services company
archetypes.hardware_devices: Designs and sells electronics, devices or computer hardware
archetypes.telecom_isp: Telecom carrier, internet provider or communications infrastructure
archetypes.data_ai: Data, analytics or AI products and services

professional_services.label: Professional & business services
professional_services.definition: Sells expert advice or professional work billed by project or hour

archetypes.management_consulting: Strategy, operations or management consulting firm
archetypes.marketing_agency: Marketing, advertising, PR, SEO or digital agency serving clients
archetypes.design_creative_studio: Design, branding, video or creative production studio
archetypes.research_testing_lab: Research, testing, inspection or certification services
archetypes.business_process_outsourcing: Call center, BPO or outsourced back-office services
archetypes.translation_media_services: Translation, publishing or media services for clients
archetypes.other: Professional services firm not listed above

construction_trades.label: Construction & trades
construction_trades.definition: Builds, installs, repairs or maintains physical structures and systems

archetypes.general_contractor: General contractor managing commercial or residential construction projects
archetypes.home_builder: Builds new homes or residential communities
archetypes.specialty_trade_contractor: Electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, painting or other trade contractor
archetypes.home_services: Residential repair, cleaning, pest control, landscaping or remodeling services
archetypes.solar_energy_installer: Sells and installs solar panels, batteries or energy upgrades
archetypes.civil_infrastructure: Roads, utilities, excavation or civil engineering construction
archetypes.facilities_services: Commercial cleaning, security guards or facility maintenance services
archetypes.other: Construction or trades business not listed above

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing & industrial
manufacturing.definition: Makes physical products in its own facilities

archetypes.industrial_manufacturer: Makes machinery, equipment, components or industrial products
archetypes.consumer_goods_manufacturer: Makes consumer products, apparel, cosmetics or household goods
archetypes.food_beverage_producer: Produces food or beverages, including breweries and wineries
archetypes.chemicals_materials: Makes chemicals, plastics, metals, paper or raw materials
archetypes.medical_device_pharma: Makes medical devices, pharmaceuticals or biotech products
archetypes.electronics_manufacturer: Makes electronic components, semiconductors or electronics
archetypes.contract_manufacturer: Manufactures products for other brands under contract

logistics_transport.label: Logistics & transportation
logistics_transport.definition: Moves or stores goods or people

archetypes.trucking_carrier: Trucking company hauling freight with its own fleet
archetypes.freight_broker_3pl: Freight broker, forwarder or third-party logistics provider
archetypes.warehousing_fulfillment: Warehousing, storage or order fulfillment services
archetypes.courier_delivery: Courier, last-mile or local delivery service
archetypes.passenger_transport: Airline, bus, limo, taxi or passenger transport operator
archetypes.moving_company: Residential or commercial moving and relocation services

archetypes.brick_and_mortar_retailer: Physical retail stores selling goods to consumers
archetypes.ecommerce_brand: Sells its own branded products online direct to consumers
archetypes.ecommerce_retailer: Online store reselling products from many brands
archetypes.franchise_operator: Operates franchised retail, restaurant or service locations
archetypes.grocery_convenience: Grocery, supermarket, convenience store or gas station
archetypes.other: Consumer retail business not listed above

hospitality_food.label: Hospitality, food service & leisure
hospitality_food.definition: Serves food, lodging, travel or entertainment to customers

archetypes.restaurant: Restaurant, cafe, bar or quick-service food business
archetypes.hotel_lodging: Hotel, resort, vacation rental or lodging operator
archetypes.travel_agency_tour: Travel agency, tour operator or travel booking business
archetypes.events_venue: Event venue, event planning or catering company
archetypes.fitness_wellness: Gym, fitness studio, spa or wellness center
archetypes.entertainment_recreation: Entertainment, gaming, sports or recreation business
archetypes.other: Hospitality or leisure business not listed above

healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.definition: Provides medical, dental, mental health or care services

archetypes.medical_practice_clinic: Physician practice, clinic or outpatient care provider
archetypes.home_health_senior_care: Home health, hospice, assisted living or senior care
archetypes.behavioral_health: Mental health, therapy or addiction treatment provider
archetypes.healthcare_staffing: Places nurses, physicians or allied health workers with facilities

education.label: Education
education.definition: Teaches or trains students or learners

archetypes.k12_school: Primary or secondary school (public, private or charter)
archetypes.edtech: Education technology or online learning company
archetypes.tutoring_test_prep: Tutoring, test prep or private lessons business
archetypes.vocational_training: Trade school, bootcamp or vocational training provider

public_nonprofit.label: Government, nonprofit & associations
public_nonprofit.definition: Non-commercial organization serving a public or member mission

archetypes.nonprofit_charity: Charity or nonprofit funded by donations and grants
archetypes.government_agency: Government department, municipality or public agency
archetypes.association_membership: Trade association, professional body or membership organization
archetypes.other: Public or nonprofit organization not listed above

energy_agriculture.label: Energy, utilities & agriculture
energy_agriculture.definition: Produces energy, resources or agricultural products

archetypes.oil_gas_mining: Oil and gas, mining or resource extraction
archetypes.renewable_energy_developer: Develops or operates renewable energy projects
archetypes.other: Energy or agriculture business not listed above

media_publishing.label: Media & publishing
media_publishing.definition: Creates and distributes content, news or entertainment

archetypes.broadcast_streaming: TV, radio, podcast or streaming media company
archetypes.film_music_production: Film, music or content production company
archetypes.creator_influencer_business: Individual creator, influencer or personal brand business
